title: The Stolen Sapphire Affair
motive: Substitution of a 100-carat blue sapphire with a glass fake before auction.

timeline.event: Baroness von Haven enters vault alone to verify sapphire.
Security team overrides lock and discovers body inside empty vault.

dialogue_placeholders.suspect_004: The sapphire was genuine when I examined it at 5:30 PM.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_005: The Baroness instructed me to wait outside the main gallery doors.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_009: I was drafting auction insurance contracts in the office.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_018: The vault lock code is known to only three trustees!
